name: Boccaccio completes the Decameron
summary: Giovanni Boccaccio completes the Decameron, a collection of one hundred novelle told by ten young Florentines fleeing the Black Death of 1348. The frame narrative is a foundational document of plague literature; the tales establish Italian prose fiction.

_quarry.structural_significance: Founding text of Western prose fiction in the vernacular; pairs with Dante and Petrarch as the 'Three Crowns' of 14th-century Italian literature.
